Ingredients :
White peas - 2 cup
Boiled aloo - 5
Onion - 1 cup
Tamarind pulp - 3 tbsp
Black sesame seeds - 1/3 cup
Dry red chili - 5
Black pepper - 1 tsp
Mustard oil - 4 tbsp
Fenugreek seeds - 1/2  tsp
Ginger - 1/2 tbsp
Green chili - 3
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Salt to taste
Coriander leaves - 1/4 cup
Lemon juice - 1 tsp".

7,105 likes, 78 comments - kabitaskitchen on October 7, 2026: "Bihari sarso wali besan ki sabzi 😋
#biharicuisine #mustard #biharipapra #kabitaskitchen #trendingreels 

Preparation time - 45 mins
Serving - 5 to 6 

ingredients:
For besan roll :
Besan (Gram flour ) - 2 cups
Water - 1 cup
Coriander leaves - 2 tbsp
Green Chilli - 3
Garlic cloves - 8
Turmeric powder - 1/3 tsp
Salt to taste
Oil for chilla

For Mustard paste :
Big mustard seeds - 4 Tbsp
Garlic - 25 gram
Cumin seeds - 1 Tbsp
Coriander seeds - 1/2 tbsp
Ginger - 2 Inch 
Green chili - 3 to 4
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Water

For curry :
Tomato - 3
Water - 2 cup
Oil - 1/4 Cup
Coriander leaves - 2 tbsp
Green chili - 2
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Red chili powder - 1 tsp
Salt to taste".
